scope: Google Earth Engine climate initialization and provider errors

behavior.initialization: Credentialed and default GEE initialization logs report only exception classes.
behavior.fetch_failures: MODIS, SMAP, Sentinel-1, and ERA5 failures return bounded summaries and log no provider exception text.
behavior.rollback: Existing source-transaction rollback behavior is preserved on failed fetch/persistence paths.

coverage: four climate provider failures are redacted from returned summaries and logs
service-account and default GEE initialization failures are redacted
failed source fetch rolls back the supplied connection

static_checks.provider_or_database_access: none; Earth Engine and connections were mocked

limitations: No Earth Engine provider, database, or candidate runtime was contacted.
This does not establish live GEE availability, data parity, or scheduled recovery.
